source.label: Held-out synthetic videos
notes: Vedauv Rajkumar Leelavathi / vedauv; dataset datasheet identifies generated observations.
CC0: Public Domain (Kaggle listing)
Synthetic videos, generated by the source author. No actual YouTube observations.
The viral label is the top 20% of views. Engagement metrics are computed from views.
Models fit 7,200 training rows using three-fold sigmoid calibration; 2,400 validation rows select the metadata model. A separate 2,400-row test set is used for evaluation.
Threshold and cohort controls explore fixed test predictions; their choices are not newly validated policies.

evidenceFlow.title: Reproduce
evidenceFlow.detail: python pipeline.py; see executed analysis.ipynb and tests.
